'''John "Lee" Greener''' was the first [[President of Solara]] after the [[Solaran War of Unification]].

== Selection ==

Old source material says the victorious coalition selected Greener as president because of his actions during the war. The source does not specify whether he was a soldier, commander, diplomat, legislator, or coalition organizer.

This draft therefore treats Greener as a political founder whose authority came from wartime legitimacy and coalition approval, without assigning him a military rank or party affiliation.

== Legacy ==

Greener's selection helped establish the presidency as the head office of the new parliamentary democratic state. In Solaran memory, he links the end of the predecessor-state war to the beginning of national institutions.
